predecessor: forward-protocol-2026-10-07.json; its first collector failed during startup history catch-up before the live subscription, so its eligible window will not be analyzed
purpose: Research a small fixed set of Deriv Bot Builder-compatible rules on new public ticks; never authorize execution.

eligibleWindow.note: Approximately 14 days, nine minutes short of a full 14-day window to fit the collector's existing 14-day run cap after the failed startup. Only ticks in this exact prospective interval are eligible.

candidateRules.indicator: Bollinger Bands on the most recent 20 ticks including decision tick; center is arithmetic mean; standard deviation is population SD; upper/lower = center +/- 2 SD.
candidateRules.direction: Rise if decision quote is strictly below lower band; Fall if strictly above upper band; otherwise NO TRADE.

candidateRules.indicator: RSI(14) using Wilder smoothing of upward/downward quote differences, seeded by the first 14 differences; current decision tick included.
candidateRules.direction: Rise if RSI is strictly below 30; Fall if strictly above 70; otherwise NO TRADE.

fixedReplayRules.entryAndExpiry: Signal at decision tick t; hypothetical entry at t+delay observed ticks; expiry at entry+5 observed ticks. No signal, lookback, entry or expiry may bridge a missing second.
fixedReplayRules.concurrency: One open hypothetical contract at a time per candidate/delay; next decision strictly after settlement.
fixedReplayRules.assumptions: Public historical ticks are not executable contract quotes. Delay and payouts are fixed sensitivity assumptions, not measured fills. No Deriv order is placed or simulated through Deriv.

evaluation.timing: No eligible-window performance inspection, candidate change, or parameter tuning before the window closes and tick-level archive audit finishes.
evaluation.coverage: Read every archived row and verify chunk SHA-256, row count, bounds, duplicates/conflicts and expected UTC seconds. At least 99.9% genuine-second coverage is required; never interpolate or bridge a gap. Report all missing seconds. If coverage falls short, result is INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluation.chronologicalHalves: Split the eligible window at its exact UTC midpoint; signal, entry and expiry must stay within one half.
evaluation.minimumTrades: At least 1000 settled hypothetical trades over the full interval and 200 in each half, for each candidate/delay scenario.
evaluation.profitCriterion: At +0.80/-1 per $1 stake, average signed outcome must be strictly positive in both chronological halves for every delay 1, 2 and 3. The full-window mean must also have a strictly positive one-sided 99.1667% hourly-block-bootstrap lower confidence bound for each delay (Bonferroni over two candidates x three delays; 10000 resamples, fixed seed 20261007).
evaluation.outcomes: If no candidate satisfies every condition: NO_TRADE. A passing candidate is only READY_FOR_SEPARATE_DEMO_REVIEW, never permission to press Run or trade.
evaluation.platformParity: Before any Bot Builder XML is considered representative, verify its actual Bollinger/RSI calculation, lookback and tick timing against these frozen definitions. If parity cannot be established, result is INCONCLUSIVE/NO_TRADE for Bot Builder.

safety.legacyArchive: The viewed 30-day archive and earlier two-week results are development evidence, not this prospective test. The known seven-second September gap is outside this window and is not silently considered complete.
